meta.name: notte
meta.description: Deploy browser automations as scheduled, API-callable serverless Functions — plus stealth sessions, vault-backed login, captcha solving, and natural-language agent runs via the Notte CLI. Turns any browser flow into a deterministic Bitterbot-callable endpoint, ideal for crystallized skills + dream-engine cron schedules.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Notte CLI 将浏览器操作部署为可调用的 API 函数，支持定时执行、自动登录和反爬绕过。
howto.when: 当需要将重复的浏览器流程固化为可调用的 API 端点，或需要定时执行浏览器任务时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Notte CLI to deploy browser automations as callable API endpoints with cron scheduling, stealth sessions, vault-backed login, and captcha solving.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to crystallize a recurring browser flow into a callable API endpoint, schedule browser tasks on a cron, or handle authenticated/anti-bot sites.

say_en.text: Open Hacker News with Notte and scrape the top 10 titles.
say_en.note: Starts a stealth session and performs extraction.

say_en.text: Deploy the current browser flow as a function, run every 2 hours.
Log into my service with Notte and scrape data.
